clauses.quote: When possible, GSD agrees not to schedule any meetings, trainings, or other activities that require teacher attendance after teacher contract time on the second Wednesday of each month.
clauses.notes: Negation embedded in verb phrase 'agrees not to schedule'.

clauses.quote: The Board, or designated representatives appointed to serve on its team, will meet with representatives designated by the Association for the purpose of establishing procedures for negotiating and reaching mutually satisfactory agreements.
clauses.subject_text: The Board, or designated representatives appointed to serve on its team

clauses.quote: Each party's negotiating team shall consist of not more than five members.
A meeting to open negotiations will be held no later than the first day of April unless mutually agreed upon by both parties.
Negotiations will be conducted at times and places mutually agreeable to the negotiators named by each party.
Before negotiations begin on specific items, the Association shall submit, in writing, specific initial proposals on any items it wishes to negotiate.

The Board shall respond within two weeks with specific written proposals to open for negotiation any items the Board wishes to negotiate that may not have been included among the initial proposals of the Association.
no new subjects for negotiation may be introduced by either party without mutual consent.
clauses.notes: Negative subject functions as joint prohibition.
